business_problem: A global pharmaceutical manufacturer needed faster, more standardized supply-chain risk analysis because manual classification, fragmented documentation, and limited visibility into alternate suppliers and materials slowed decisions and reduced resilience.
solution_summary: The manufacturer worked with IBM Consulting to build a modular risk-orchestration platform on the IBM watsonx AI portfolio and AWS cloud services. The solution unifies data from execution, planning, procurement, logistics, and third-party risk providers so teams can ask natural-language questions and review a common set of risk signals instead of compiling reports manually. Within that platform, generative AI supports multidimensional risk analysis, automated gap identification, and summarized risk correlation, while a virtual assistant uses an LLM text-to-SQL capability to answer supply-chain questions, handle unsupported-query exceptions, and provide bilingual access. The system surfaces at-risk suppliers and sites, maps bills of materials, shows 12-month inventory projections, highlights revenue exposure, and suggests alternate sites or materials. That architecture turns scattered risk monitoring into a real-time decision layer for executives and supply-chain teams.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx
solution_components.role: Provides the AI foundation for risk analysis, summarization, and natural-language interrogation of supply-chain data.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx Orchestrate
solution_components.role: Supports the orchestration of modular risk workflows and executive escalations across the supply chain.

solution_components.name: AWS cloud services
solution_components.role: Hosts the scalable risk-orchestration platform that integrates supply-chain and third-party risk data.

data_flow: Execution, planning, procurement, logistics, and third-party risk data are consolidated into the watsonx-based platform on AWS, where generative AI analyzes correlations, an LLM interface answers natural-language questions and text-to-SQL requests, and the resulting risk alerts, impact views, and alternate-supply recommendations are escalated to executives and planners.
business_outcome: The manufacturer cut supply-chain decision time from weeks to days, assessed and escalated large volumes of risk events, prevented stock-outs in top products, and improved agility and transparency across its network.
metrics: >95% reduction in decision cycle time, with proactive highlighting of risks and improved visibility across the supply chain network
